target.title: Keep legacy WhatsApp crontab lint opt-in
target.body:
## Summary
- mark `core/doctor/legacy-whatsapp-crontab` default-disabled so default `doctor --lint` does not invoke the shell-backed `crontab -l` probe
- preserve explicit selection through `--only core/doctor/legacy-whatsapp-crontab` and `--all`
- add selection coverage proving default lint skips the probe while selected lint reports the warning

## Public surface
- No public SDK/plugin/config contract changes.
- Default `doctor --lint` changes only by skipping this live crontab probe; `--all` and `--only` still include it.
- Real repair/reporting behavior for the legacy WhatsApp crontab path remains owned by the existing Doctor implementation.

## PR surface
- 2 files changed, +45/-2 after rebasing on current `main` and resolving adjacent #99249/#99211 test coverage.

## Real behavior proof
- Head verified: `489e2af37056c2f78a43b282dd0c81d74193a9df`.
- Command: `pnpm exec vitest run src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts --maxWorkers 1 --no-fileParallelism`.
- Result: pass, 1 file / 70 tests.
- Behavior covered: default lint selection skips `core/doctor/legacy-whatsapp-crontab` without calling `collectLegacyWhatsAppCrontabHealthWarning`; explicit `--only core/doctor/legacy-whatsapp-crontab` runs the check and reports the warning finding.

## Validation
- `pnpm exec vitest run src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts --maxWorkers 1 --no-fileParallelism`
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check src/flows/doctor-core-checks.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts`
- `pnpm exec oxlint src/flows/doctor-core-checks.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts`
- `git diff --check`

## Not tested / baseline gaps
- Full `pnpm exec tsgo --noEmit --project tsconfig.json --pretty false` currently fails outside this PR in `src/config/io.ts` / `src/secrets/config-io.ts` around `configWritePostCommitRollback` exported type naming. This PR does not touch those files.
- I did not run the cron storage implementation test file; this PR only changes lint default selection for the existing WhatsApp crontab check and leaves storage/repair behavior unchanged.
